ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 20% off bestsellers, but only 1 of 23 ads mentions it. A cold buyer has no reason to act. Put the 20% off in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
12 of 23 copy ads open on the same “tell your story” line, so they all speak to the same buyer. Run three new angles against it: the opal pieces, the letter bracelet, and the stackable ring.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a gift buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

17 Shop now ads send buyers to your homepage, not the product on screen. A buyer who clicked a bracelet has to search again. Point each one to the exact piece the ad shows, such as the letter bracelet.
